description: Character-specific lmask profile based on the bundled Rey Mysterio 2019 mask_color texture. This is a 2048 x 2048 flat UV / cutout-style mask_color layout with separate mask islands, lower bib/panel zones, side/corner padding, and visible artwork islands.

logic_grid.notes: 128 x 128 normalized lmask-layout grid. Each cell is exactly 16 px on a 2048 x 2048 texture.

default_texture_note: Bundled Rey Mysterio 2019 stock/default mask_color texture included in the Final Handoff Pack. Use it as the UV footprint authority for mask island shapes, side-wrap behavior, eye openings, lower bib panels, corner padding, and opaque edge padding.
layout_reference_usage: Upload the layout reference PNG and 128 x 128 grid PNG with the final handoff pack. These are placement guides only; do not copy guide colors, labels, or grid lines into the final mask texture.
reference_usage: Use the bundled default texture as the layout/UV footprint authority, not as artwork to copy exactly. Generate original mask_color.png artwork that follows this profile footprint, plus mask_mask1.png and mask_nrm.png.

full_canvas.purpose: Full mask_color canvas; keep 2048 x 2048 square.

background_padding.purpose: Dark/opaque UV padding and non-feature areas. Do not make transparent unless the actual source alpha proves it.

upper_left_crown_island.purpose: Upper-left curved crown/strap island from stock texture.

upper_right_crown_island.purpose: Upper-right curved crown/strap island from stock texture.

left_side_mask_island.purpose: Left tall curved side mask island with main color/trim.

right_side_mask_island.purpose: Right tall curved side mask island with main color/trim.

left_name_tag.purpose: Far-left vertical name/text island on stock texture. Avoid text unless intentionally requested.

lower_center_padding.purpose: Lower center dark/padding area. Do not place main identity here unless the selected stock item uses it.

outer_corner_padding.purpose: Outer corner UV padding/bleed. Keep compatible colors; avoid major artwork in corners.

must: Use 2048 x 2048 as the default production canvas.
Use the bundled Rey Mysterio 2019 default mask_color texture as the UV footprint authority.
Follow the separate cutout islands and do not reinterpret this as a continuous hood-wrap mask.
Use the 128 x 128 layout/grid references for placement accuracy.
Generate mask_color.png, mask_mask1.png, and mask_nrm.png together for final output.
avoid: Do not copy guide colors, labels, or grid lines into final mask_color.png.
Do not turn this into face paint, a poster, a portrait, or a full wrestler body mockup.
Do not ignore the cutout islands, lower bib panels, side islands, or outer padding.
